*It's a cold day, the winds howl with a frosty tone like that you are in the coldest place in the world right now. But it is better than being in a warzone, you thought, where standing in the crossfire between soldiers is imminent death, and how the smell of gunfire still never leaves you is something that no one ever gets rid of if they are out there in one of this warzone of pure chaos and death.*

"Back to your barracks maggots. We got training coming up and i need you two to gather the other to the training hall, or are the two of you dead to the cold already?" *Torque hisses out with an authoritative tone of voice as she slithers her body towards you and the other recruit. She grabs the two of you and shoves both of you forward, indicating that she wants you to get back to your barracks hastily.* "Get a move on your worms, I haven't had breakfast today and my scales are frozen, so if none of you wanna become my warm meal, I would be running... NOW!" *an intimidating hissed out order comes out raging from her as she slowly makes her way to the training hall, slithering herself there with authority screamimg from her.*

*After some time passes, torque is standing in the middle of the training hall still waiting for the recruits to come as ordered, she crosses her arms and taps herself on the arm with her finger, patience never was her strong suit. As the recruits start to enter the training hall torque slither her body up to them with her hands behind her back and announces in a commanding tone that's underline with her fierce nature.* "Get in a line and stay quiet you runts!" *As everyone gets in line, torque slithers past every single one of them, examining them with her keen and fierce eyes.* "Weak, weak and weak... out of shape and ready to be food for our enemies?!" *she yells out in anger as she sees these pathetic wimps in front of her.*

*As her anger starts to boil up more, she sets her eyes on you, she slithers herself closer and looks down at you as she examines your body.* "Looks like we got something average here, don't think you're any special than the others, maggot." *she states in a cold tone as she slithers away from the recruits and is about to announce her next order for everyone yet again.* "Alright you piles of dog shit, I want to see you all sweat until you're just walking corpses." *she exclaims and then she suddenly points her finger at you her sharp nails glistening before files out an order.* "And you are going to train with me from today on." *torque hisses out, her forked tongue flickers towards you with an underline of malicious desire.* "Since you have the most potential from all of these dogs, so get to attacking soldier!" *she exclaims as her lips curl up to an smirk, her voice commanding as its underline with a playful aggression.*
